verses.text: Sing to the LORD a new song; Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.textZh: 你們要向耶和華唱新歌！全地都要向耶和華歌唱！

verses.text: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; Proclaim good tidings of His salvation from day to day.
verses.textZh: 要向耶和華歌唱，稱頌他的名！天天傳揚他的救恩！

verses.text: Tell of His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all the peoples.
verses.textZh: 在列邦中述說他的榮耀！在萬民中述說他的奇事！

verses.text: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textZh: 因耶和華為大，當受極大的讚美；他在萬神之上，當受敬畏。

verses.text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, But the LORD made the heavens.
verses.textZh: 外邦的神都屬虛無；惟獨耶和華創造諸天。

verses.text: Splendor and majesty are before Him, Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.
verses.textZh: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前；有能力與華美在他聖所。

verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the peoples, Ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.textZh: 民中的萬族啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華，都歸給耶和華！

verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory of His name; Bring an offering and come into His courts.
verses.textZh: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他，拿供物來進入他的院宇。

verses.text: Worship the LORD in holy attire; Tremble before Him, all the earth.
verses.textZh: 當以聖潔的（的：或譯為）妝飾敬拜耶和華；全地要在他面前戰抖！

verses.text: Say among the nations, 'The LORD reigns; Indeed, the world is firmly established, it will not be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.'
verses.textZh: 人在列邦中要說：耶和華作王！世界就堅定，不得動搖；他要按公正審判眾民。

verses.text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and all it contains;
verses.textZh: 願天歡喜，願地快樂！願海和其中所充滿的澎湃！

verses.text: Let the field exult, and all that is in it. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
verses.textZh: 願田和其中所有的都歡樂！那時，林中的樹木都要在耶和華面前歡呼。

verses.text: Before the LORD, for He is coming, For He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness And the peoples in His faithfulness.
verses.textZh: 因為他來了，他來要審判全地。他要按公義審判世界，按他的信實審判萬民。
